research_notes.finding: Pattern: Free tier has 60 requests/minute limit Implementation: Use request queue with debouncing Error handling: Exponential backoff on 429 (Too Many Requests) Retry logic: wait 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s between retries

Patterns: - Limit input length to avoid token limits (10k chars for gemini-pro) - Use structured prompts for consistent output format - Ask for JSON response for easy parsing - Include examples in prompt for desired output style - Temperature 0.7 for balanced creativity - Max output tokens 1024 for summaries
Pattern: No existing metadata extraction implementation found This is greenfield development for Story 6.4

architecture_patterns.pattern: Use Dexie's bulkPut() for efficient batch updates Pattern: await db.sources.bulkPut([source1, source2, ...]) Benefits: Single transaction, better performance

Use CSS custom properties for consistent styling: - Colors: --color-primary, --color-surface-dark - Spacing: --spacing-1 through --spacing-4 - Border: --border-dark, --shadow-pixel - Typography: --text-foreground, --text-muted-foreground

technical_notes.note: Content truncation: Limit API input to 10k characters Use: content.substring(0, 10000) for prompt context For longer documents, implement chunking in future stories

Error handling fallback: If Gemini API fails, fall back to basic metadata Basic metadata: title, page count, word count (from Story 6.1) Set summary to "AI analysis unavailable" Set keyConcepts to empty array [] Set suggestedQuestions to empty array []

Prompt engineering templates: - Summary: "Generate a 3-sentence summary..." - Concepts: "Extract 5 key concepts as JSON array..." - Questions: "Generate 3 thought-provoking questions as JSON array..."
Include validation instructions to ensure proper JSON parsing Use try-catch for JSON.parse() with fallback to empty array

Metadata extraction timing: - Trigger: After source import completes (post-processing) - User experience: Show progress indicator "Analyzing with AI..." - Timeout: 30 second timeout for API calls - Retry: Allow manual retry via "Extract Metadata" button

Color generation for key concept tags: Use hash-based color assignment for consistency Palette: blue, green, purple, orange, pink (from design tokens) Pattern: const color = hashToColor(concept) returns color string

Future enhancements (out of scope for Story 6.4): - Chunking for very long documents (>10k chars) - Incremental metadata updates - Metadata caching to avoid re-analysis - Batch metadata extraction for multiple sources
